programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')

file=programs/'task-6cfef789.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [[grid[n - 1 - r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    counterclockwise = [[grid[r][n - 1 - c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    halfturn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    top = [list(grid[r]) + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)]
    bottom = [counterclockwise[r] + halfturn[r] for r in range(n)]
    return top + bottom
'''
file.write_text(source)
